name: Chimney Cooling
steps: Tap watermelon to cool her down.
Tap coat to remove extra warm clothing.
Tap air conditioner to blow cold air.
Tap phone to read emotional message.
Tap window to open and let cold air in.
Tap glue to stick him to the floor.
Tap man to make him feel cold sweat.
Drag ice cubes into the boiling pot.
Tap pot lid to release steam and freeze area.
Tap sheet on sofa to create ghost disguise and clear the level.
